items.question: Trong câu "A graph is simply nodes + connections: a finite (and possibly changing) set of vertices together with a set of edges — unordered pairs of vertices in an undirected graph, ordered pairs in a directed one.", từ "finite" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A graph is simply nodes + connections: a finite (and possibly changing) set of vertices together with a set of edges — unordered pairs of vertices in an undirected graph, ordered pairs in a directed one.", what does "finite" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: finite /ˈfaɪnaɪt/ (tính từ): hữu hạn. "A finite set" = một tập hợp có số phần tử giới hạn; trái nghĩa là "infinite" (vô hạn).
items.explanationEn: finite /ˈfaɪnaɪt/ (adjective): limited in number. "A finite set" has a countable, limited number of elements; the opposite is "infinite".

items.question: Trong câu "A graph is simply nodes + connections: a finite (and possibly changing) set of vertices together with a set of edges — unordered pairs of vertices in an undirected graph, ordered pairs in a directed one.", từ "pair" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A graph is simply nodes + connections: a finite (and possibly changing) set of vertices together with a set of edges — unordered pairs of vertices in an undirected graph, ordered pairs in a directed one.", what does "pair" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pair /per/ (danh từ): cặp, đôi. "Unordered pairs of vertices" = các cặp đỉnh không phân biệt thứ tự; "in pairs" = theo từng cặp.
items.explanationEn: pair /per/ (noun): a set of two things. "Unordered pairs of vertices" are two-vertex sets where order does not matter; "in pairs" means two at a time.

items.question: Trong câu "Unlike a tree, a graph has no root, no parent/child rule, and may contain cycles.", từ "unlike" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unlike a tree, a graph has no root, no parent/child rule, and may contain cycles.", what does "unlike" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (giới từ): khác với. "Unlike X, Y..." dùng ở đầu câu để so sánh sự khác biệt giữa hai thứ.
items.explanationEn: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (preposition): different from. "Unlike X, Y..." opens a sentence to contrast two things.

items.question: Trong câu "Unlike a tree, a graph has no root, no parent/child rule, and may contain cycles.", từ "contain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unlike a tree, a graph has no root, no parent/child rule, and may contain cycles.", what does "contain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (động từ): chứa, bao gồm. "May contain cycles" = có thể chứa chu trình; nghĩa khác "contain the damage" = kiềm chế thiệt hại.
items.explanationEn: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (verb): to have inside. "May contain cycles" means cycles can be present; another sense, "contain the damage", means to limit it.

items.question: Trong câu "The price: algorithms must cope with cycles, which is why every traversal here keeps a visited set.", từ "cope with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The price: algorithms must cope with cycles, which is why every traversal here keeps a visited set.", what does "cope with" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cope with /koʊp wɪð/ (cụm từ): xử lý được. "Cope with a problem" = đối phó, xử lý được một vấn đề khó.
items.explanationEn: cope with /koʊp wɪð/ (phrase): to deal with successfully. "Cope with a problem" means to handle a difficulty successfully.

items.question: Trong câu "The price: algorithms must cope with cycles, which is why every traversal here keeps a visited set.", từ "price" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The price: algorithms must cope with cycles, which is why every traversal here keeps a visited set.", what does "price" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: price /praɪs/ (danh từ): cái giá phải trả. "The price" ở đây là cái giá (nhược điểm) phải chấp nhận để có lợi ích, không phải giá tiền.
items.explanationEn: price /praɪs/ (noun): a downside you accept. "The price" here is the cost or downside of a benefit, not an amount of money.

items.question: Trong câu "Maps and navigation — intersections are vertices, roads are weighted edges.", từ "intersection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Maps and navigation — intersections are vertices, roads are weighted edges.", what does "intersection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: intersection /ˌɪntərˈsekʃn/ (danh từ): giao lộ, ngã tư. "Intersections are vertices" = các giao lộ là đỉnh; trong toán, "intersection" còn là phần giao của hai tập hợp.
items.explanationEn: intersection /ˌɪntərˈsekʃn/ (noun): a place where roads cross. "Intersections are vertices" means road crossings are nodes; in maths it also means the shared part of two sets.

items.question: Trong câu "Web crawlers — pages are vertices, links are directed edges.", từ "crawler" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Web crawlers — pages are vertices, links are directed edges.", what does "crawler" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a program that browses web pages
a program that edits web pages
items.explanation: crawler /ˈkrɔːlər/ (danh từ): chương trình thu thập web. "Web crawler" = bot tự động đi theo liên kết để thu thập trang, dùng bởi công cụ tìm kiếm.
items.explanationEn: crawler /ˈkrɔːlər/ (noun): a program that browses web pages. A "web crawler" is a bot that follows links to collect pages, as search engines do.

items.question: Trong câu "Dependencies, games, mazes, file systems — build steps, board states, cells, folders.", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dependencies, games, mazes, file systems — build steps, board states, cells, folders.", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): sự phụ thuộc. "Dependencies" = các thứ phụ thuộc lẫn nhau, ví dụ bước build B cần bước A xong trước.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): something another thing relies on. "Dependencies" are things that rely on others, e.g. build step B needs step A first.

items.question: Trong câu "Dependencies, games, mazes, file systems — build steps, board states, cells, folders.", từ "maze" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dependencies, games, mazes, file systems — build steps, board states, cells, folders.", what does "maze" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: maze /meɪz/ (danh từ): mê cung. "Solve a maze" = giải mê cung; mỗi ô là một đỉnh, lối đi giữa các ô là cạnh.
items.explanationEn: maze /meɪz/ (noun): a network of confusing paths. "Solve a maze" means find a way through it; each cell is a vertex and each passage an edge.

items.question: Trong câu "A directed edge has an arrow: you can follow someone on Instagram without them following you back.", từ "directed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A directed edge has an arrow: you can follow someone on Instagram without them following you back.", what does "directed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: directed /dəˈrektɪd/ (tính từ): có hướng. "Directed graph" = đồ thị có hướng; nghĩa thường ngày "directed by" = do ai đạo diễn/chỉ đạo.
items.explanationEn: directed /dəˈrektɪd/ (adjective): going one way only. "Directed graph" has one-way edges; in everyday use, "directed by" means managed or filmed by someone.

items.question: Trong câu "A weighted edge carries a value — kilometres, minutes, cost.", từ "weighted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A weighted edge carries a value — kilometres, minutes, cost.", what does "weighted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: weighted /ˈweɪtɪd/ (tính từ): có trọng số. "Weighted edge" = cạnh mang giá trị như khoảng cách, thời gian hoặc chi phí.
items.explanationEn: weighted /ˈweɪtɪd/ (adjective): having a value attached. A "weighted edge" carries a number such as distance, time or cost.

items.question: Trong câu "A weighted edge carries a value — kilometres, minutes, cost.", từ "carry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A weighted edge carries a value — kilometres, minutes, cost.", what does "carry" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: carry /ˈkæri/ (động từ): mang (thông tin). "Carry a value" = mang một giá trị; nghĩa gốc "carry a bag" = xách, mang vác.
items.explanationEn: carry /ˈkæri/ (verb): to hold as data. "Carry a value" means to hold a value; the basic sense, "carry a bag", means to lift and move it.

items.question: Trong câu "An undirected graph has at most V(V-1)/2 edges, a directed one at most V(V-1).", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An undirected graph has at most V(V-1)/2 edges, a directed one at most V(V-1).", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at most /æt moʊst/ (cụm từ): nhiều nhất là. "At most N" = tối đa N; ngược lại là "at least N" = tối thiểu N.
items.explanationEn: at most /æt moʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "At most N" means N is the upper limit; the opposite is "at least N".

items.question: Trong câu "An adjacency matrix is a V × V grid: cell [i][j] is 1 if there is an edge from i to j, else 0 (store the weight for weighted graphs).", từ "grid" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An adjacency matrix is a V × V grid: cell [i][j] is 1 if there is an edge from i to j, else 0 (store the weight for weighted graphs).", what does "grid" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a pattern of rows and columns
items.explanation: grid /ɡrɪd/ (danh từ): lưới ô vuông. "A V × V grid" = lưới V hàng V cột; "power grid" = lưới điện là nghĩa khác.
items.explanationEn: grid /ɡrɪd/ (noun): a pattern of rows and columns. "A V × V grid" has V rows and V columns; "power grid" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "An undirected graph gives a symmetric matrix; a directed one need not.", từ "symmetric" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An undirected graph gives a symmetric matrix; a directed one need not.", what does "symmetric" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: symmetric /sɪˈmetrɪk/ (tính từ): đối xứng. "A symmetric matrix" = ma trận đối xứng, ô [i][j] bằng ô [j][i].
items.explanationEn: symmetric /sɪˈmetrɪk/ (adjective): the same on both sides. In "a symmetric matrix", cell [i][j] equals cell [j][i].

items.question: Trong câu "An undirected graph gives a symmetric matrix; a directed one need not.", từ "need not" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An undirected graph gives a symmetric matrix; a directed one need not.", what does "need not" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: need not /niːd nɑːt/ (cụm từ): không nhất thiết. "A directed one need not (be symmetric)" = đồ thị có hướng không nhất thiết đối xứng.
items.explanationEn: need not /niːd nɑːt/ (phrase): is not required to. "A directed one need not" means it does not have to be symmetric, though it can be.

items.question: Trong câu "Weakness: always O(V²) memory, even with almost no edges, and listing a vertex's neighbours scans a whole row, O(V).", từ "weakness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weakness: always O(V²) memory, even with almost no edges, and listing a vertex's neighbours scans a whole row, O(V).", what does "weakness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: weakness /ˈwiːknəs/ (danh từ): điểm yếu. "Strength / weakness" = ưu điểm / nhược điểm, thường dùng khi so sánh giải pháp.
items.explanationEn: weakness /ˈwiːknəs/ (noun): a disadvantage. "Strength / weakness" pairs are used to compare solutions.

items.question: Trong câu "Weakness: always O(V²) memory, even with almost no edges, and listing a vertex's neighbours scans a whole row, O(V).", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weakness: always O(V²) memory, even with almost no edges, and listing a vertex's neighbours scans a whole row, O(V).", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to look through one by one
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): duyệt qua lần lượt. "Scan a row" = duyệt từng ô trong hàng; "scan a document" = quét tài liệu là nghĩa khác.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to look through one by one. "Scan a row" means to check each cell in turn; "scan a document" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "In short: lists use less space on sparse graphs and iterate edges faster; matrices look up a specific edge instantly.", từ "sparse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In short: lists use less space on sparse graphs and iterate edges faster; matrices look up a specific edge instantly.", what does "sparse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sparse /spɑːrs/ (tính từ): thưa thớt. "Sparse graph" = đồ thị thưa, số cạnh E gần V; trái nghĩa là "dense".
items.explanationEn: sparse /spɑːrs/ (adjective): having few items. A "sparse graph" has E close to V; the opposite is "dense".

items.question: Trong câu "In short: lists use less space on sparse graphs and iterate edges faster; matrices look up a specific edge instantly.", từ "look up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In short: lists use less space on sparse graphs and iterate edges faster; matrices look up a specific edge instantly.", what does "look up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: look up /lʊk ʌp/ (cụm từ): tra cứu. "Look up an edge" = tra cứu xem cạnh có tồn tại; danh từ là "lookup". Nghĩa khác: "things are looking up" = đang khá lên.
items.explanationEn: look up /lʊk ʌp/ (phrase): to search for information. "Look up an edge" means to check whether it exists; the noun is "lookup". "Things are looking up" means improving.

items.question: Trong câu "In short: lists use less space on sparse graphs and iterate edges faster; matrices look up a specific edge instantly.", từ "instantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In short: lists use less space on sparse graphs and iterate edges faster; matrices look up a specific edge instantly.", what does "instantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: instantly /ˈɪnstəntli/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. "Look up ... instantly" = tra cứu ngay lập tức, tức là O(1).
items.explanationEn: instantly /ˈɪnstəntli/ (adverb): immediately. "Look up ... instantly" means in constant time, O(1).

items.question: Trong câu "Memory matches what exists: one entry per vertex plus two per undirected edge, O(V + E).", từ "entry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memory matches what exists: one entry per vertex plus two per undirected edge, O(V + E).", what does "entry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: entry /ˈentri/ (danh từ): mục, phần tử. "One entry per vertex" = mỗi đỉnh một mục; "entry" còn có nghĩa lối vào.
items.explanationEn: entry /ˈentri/ (noun): one item in a record. "One entry per vertex" means one item for each vertex; "entry" can also mean a way in.

items.question: Trong câu "Memory matches what exists: one entry per vertex plus two per undirected edge, O(V + E).", từ "match" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Memory matches what exists: one entry per vertex plus two per undirected edge, O(V + E).", what does "match" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: match /mætʃ/ (động từ): tương ứng với. "Memory matches what exists" = bộ nhớ tương ứng đúng với những gì có thật; danh từ "match" = trận đấu.
items.explanationEn: match /mætʃ/ (verb): to correspond to. "Memory matches what exists" means it corresponds exactly; the noun "match" can mean a game.

items.question: Trong câu "In short: lists use less space on sparse graphs and iterate edges faster; matrices look up a specific edge instantly.", từ "iterate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In short: lists use less space on sparse graphs and iterate edges faster; matrices look up a specific edge instantly.", what does "iterate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go through one by one
items.explanation: iterate /ˈɪtəreɪt/ (động từ): duyệt lặp qua. "Iterate edges" = lặp qua từng cạnh; "iterate over an array" là cụm rất phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: iterate /ˈɪtəreɪt/ (verb): to go through one by one. "Iterate edges" means to loop over each edge; "iterate over an array" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "So the adjacency list is the default and is what we build.", từ "default" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So the adjacency list is the default and is what we build.", what does "default" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (danh từ): lựa chọn mặc định. "The default" = lựa chọn mặc định, dùng khi không có lý do đặc biệt; "default on a loan" = vỡ nợ.
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (noun): the usual choice. "The default" is the standard choice; "default on a loan" means failing to repay it.

items.question: Trong câu "Use a matrix for small or dense graphs, or when the algorithm constantly asks "does edge (u, v) exist?".", từ "dense" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use a matrix for small or dense graphs, or when the algorithm constantly asks "does edge (u, v) exist?".", what does "dense" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dense /dens/ (tính từ): dày đặc. "Dense graph" = đồ thị dày, E gần V²; nghĩa lóng "dense" = chậm hiểu.
items.explanationEn: dense /dens/ (adjective): packed closely. A "dense graph" has E close to V²; informally, "dense" can mean slow to understand.

items.question: Trong câu "Use a matrix for small or dense graphs, or when the algorithm constantly asks "does edge (u, v) exist?".", từ "constantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use a matrix for small or dense graphs, or when the algorithm constantly asks "does edge (u, v) exist?".", what does "constantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: constantly /ˈkɑːnstəntli/ (trạng từ): liên tục. "Constantly asks" = hỏi liên tục; lưu ý "constant time" = thời gian hằng số O(1).
items.explanationEn: constantly /ˈkɑːnstəntli/ (adverb): all the time. "Constantly asks" means asks again and again; compare "constant time", O(1).

items.question: Trong câu "The guard in addVertex stops a repeated call from wiping existing edges.", từ "guard" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The guard in addVertex stops a repeated call from wiping existing edges.", what does "guard" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a check that blocks a case
items.explanation: guard /ɡɑːrd/ (danh từ): câu điều kiện chặn. "The guard" = điều kiện kiểm tra ở đầu hàm để chặn trường hợp xấu; "guard clause" rất hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: guard /ɡɑːrd/ (noun): a check that blocks a case. "The guard" is a check that stops a bad case early; "guard clause" is a common term.

items.question: Trong câu "The guard in addVertex stops a repeated call from wiping existing edges.", từ "wipe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The guard in addVertex stops a repeated call from wiping existing edges.", what does "wipe" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: wipe /waɪp/ (động từ): xóa sạch. "Wipe existing edges" = xóa sạch các cạnh đang có; nghĩa gốc "wipe the table" = lau bàn.
items.explanationEn: wipe /waɪp/ (verb): to erase completely. "Wipe existing edges" means to erase them all; the basic sense, "wipe the table", means to clean it.

items.question: Trong câu "The guard in addVertex stops a repeated call from wiping existing edges.", từ "repeated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The guard in addVertex stops a repeated call from wiping existing edges.", what does "repeated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: repeated /rɪˈpiːtɪd/ (tính từ): lặp lại nhiều lần. "A repeated call" = một lần gọi lặp lại cùng tham số.
items.explanationEn: repeated /rɪˈpiːtɪd/ (adjective): happening again. "A repeated call" is the same call made again.

items.question: Trong câu "The guard in addVertex stops a repeated call from wiping existing edges.", từ "existing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The guard in addVertex stops a repeated call from wiping existing edges.", what does "existing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: existing /ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ/ (tính từ): đang có, hiện có. "Existing edges" = các cạnh đã tồn tại; "existing code" = mã hiện có.
items.explanationEn: existing /ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ/ (adjective): already present. "Existing edges" are edges already there; "existing code" is code already written.

items.question: Trong câu "No duplicate edges: a Set per vertex instead of an array.", từ "duplicate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No duplicate edges: a Set per vertex instead of an array.", what does "duplicate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈduːplɪkət/ (tính từ): trùng lặp. "Duplicate edges" = cạnh bị trùng; Set tự động loại bỏ phần tử trùng lặp.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈduːplɪkət/ (adjective): exactly copied. "Duplicate edges" are repeated copies; a Set removes duplicates automatically.

items.question: Trong câu "No duplicate edges: a Set per vertex instead of an array.", từ "instead of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No duplicate edges: a Set per vertex instead of an array.", what does "instead of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "A instead of B" = dùng A thay cho B.
items.explanationEn: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (phrase): in place of. "A instead of B" means using A in place of B.

items.question: Trong câu "removeVertex must not just delete the key: every neighbour would keep a dangling reference, and a later traversal would crash reading this.adjacencyList["Hong Kong"] as undefined.", từ "dangling" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "removeVertex must not just delete the key: every neighbour would keep a dangling reference, and a later traversal would crash reading this.adjacencyList["Hong Kong"] as undefined.", what does "dangling" (adjective) mean?
options: treo, trỏ tới thứ đã mất
items.explanation: dangling /ˈdæŋɡlɪŋ/ (tính từ): treo, trỏ tới thứ đã mất. "Dangling reference/pointer" = tham chiếu treo, trỏ tới dữ liệu không còn tồn tại.
items.explanationEn: dangling /ˈdæŋɡlɪŋ/ (adjective): pointing to something gone. A "dangling reference" points to data that no longer exists.

items.question: Trong câu "removeVertex must not just delete the key: every neighbour would keep a dangling reference, and a later traversal would crash reading this.adjacencyList["Hong Kong"] as undefined.", từ "reference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "removeVertex must not just delete the key: every neighbour would keep a dangling reference, and a later traversal would crash reading this.adjacencyList["Hong Kong"] as undefined.", what does "reference" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reference /ˈrefrəns/ (danh từ): tham chiếu. "Keep a reference" = giữ một tham chiếu tới dữ liệu; "reference letter" = thư giới thiệu.
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈrefrəns/ (noun): a pointer to data. "Keep a reference" means to hold a pointer to data; a "reference letter" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "removeVertex must not just delete the key: every neighbour would keep a dangling reference, and a later traversal would crash reading this.adjacencyList["Hong Kong"] as undefined.", từ "crash" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "removeVertex must not just delete the key: every neighbour would keep a dangling reference, and a later traversal would crash reading this.adjacencyList["Hong Kong"] as undefined.", what does "crash" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: crash /kræʃ/ (động từ): bị lỗi dừng đột ngột. "The program would crash" = chương trình sẽ sập; nghĩa khác "crash a car" = đâm xe.
items.explanationEn: crash /kræʃ/ (verb): to stop working suddenly. "Would crash" means the program would fail suddenly; "crash a car" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "So it removes every incident edge first, then deletes the key.", từ "incident" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So it removes every incident edge first, then deletes the key.", what does "incident" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incident /ˈɪnsɪdənt/ (tính từ): nối vào (một đỉnh). "Incident edge" = cạnh nối với đỉnh đang xét; danh từ "incident" = sự cố.
items.explanationEn: incident /ˈɪnsɪdənt/ (adjective): touching a given vertex. An "incident edge" touches the vertex in question; the noun "incident" means an event or problem.

items.question: Trong câu "So it removes every incident edge first, then deletes the key.", từ "key" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So it removes every incident edge first, then deletes the key.", what does "key" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a name in a key-value pair
a tool to open a lock
the data stored for a name
items.explanation: key /kiː/ (danh từ): khóa (của object). "Delete the key" = xóa khóa khỏi object; "key" còn là chìa khóa hoặc phím bấm.
items.explanationEn: key /kiː/ (noun): a name in a key-value pair. "Delete the key" means removing the property name from the object; "key" can also mean a door key or a keyboard button.

items.question: Trong câu "Weighted: push objects, { node: v2, weight } — the shape Dijkstra's algorithm uses next topic.", từ "shape" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weighted: push objects, { node: v2, weight } — the shape Dijkstra's algorithm uses next topic.", what does "shape" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shape /ʃeɪp/ (danh từ): cấu trúc, dạng dữ liệu. "The shape of an object" = cấu trúc các trường của nó; "in good shape" = khỏe mạnh.
items.explanationEn: shape /ʃeɪp/ (noun): the structure of data. "The shape" of an object is its set of fields; "in good shape" means healthy.

items.question: Trong câu "Traversal means visiting, updating or checking every vertex reachable from a start.", từ "traversal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Traversal means visiting, updating or checking every vertex reachable from a start.", what does "traversal" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the act of halving a search
the act of crossing a border
the act of visiting each item
items.explanation: traversal /trəˈvɜːrsl/ (danh từ): sự duyệt qua. "Graph traversal" = duyệt đồ thị, đi qua các đỉnh theo quy tắc nhất định.
items.explanationEn: traversal /trəˈvɜːrsl/ (noun): the act of visiting each item. "Graph traversal" is visiting vertices by a fixed rule.

items.question: Trong câu "Traversal means visiting, updating or checking every vertex reachable from a start.", từ "reachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Traversal means visiting, updating or checking every vertex reachable from a start.", what does "reachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (tính từ): có thể đến được. "Reachable from a start" = có đường đi từ đỉnh xuất phát tới; "unreachable" = không tới được.
items.explanationEn: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (adjective): able to be reached. "Reachable from a start" means a path exists from the start; the opposite is "unreachable".

items.question: Trong câu "You traversed trees with BFS and DFS before.", từ "traverse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You traversed trees with BFS and DFS before.", what does "traverse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: traverse /trəˈvɜːrs/ (động từ): duyệt qua. "Traverse a tree" = duyệt cây; nghĩa gốc "traverse a mountain" = băng qua núi.
items.explanationEn: traverse /trəˈvɜːrs/ (verb): to visit every node. "Traverse a tree" means to visit every node; the basic sense is to travel across.

items.question: Trong câu "A visited set (object or Set) marks each vertex the first time it is seen, so it is processed once.", từ "mark" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A visited set (object or Set) marks each vertex the first time it is seen, so it is processed once.", what does "mark" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mark /mɑːrk/ (động từ): đánh dấu. "Mark a vertex as visited" = đánh dấu đỉnh đã thăm; "mark exams" = chấm bài.
items.explanationEn: mark /mɑːrk/ (verb): to label as done. "Mark a vertex as visited" means to label it; "mark exams" means to grade them.

items.question: Trong câu "A visited set (object or Set) marks each vertex the first time it is seen, so it is processed once.", từ "process" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A visited set (object or Set) marks each vertex the first time it is seen, so it is processed once.", what does "process" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: process /ˈprɑːses/ (động từ): xử lý. "It is processed once" = nó chỉ được xử lý một lần; danh từ "process" = tiến trình.
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprɑːses/ (verb): to handle data. "It is processed once" means handled a single time; the noun "process" means a running program or a procedure.

items.question: Trong câu "The neighbour order in each array decides the exact output, so several different orders can all be valid.", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The neighbour order in each array decides the exact output, so several different orders can all be valid.", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvælɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ, đúng. "Can all be valid" = đều có thể là đáp án đúng; "a valid input" = đầu vào hợp lệ.
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvælɪd/ (adjective): acceptable and correct. "Can all be valid" means all are correct answers; "a valid input" is acceptable input.

items.question: Trong câu "Depth-first search (DFS) goes as far as possible down one branch before backtracking.", từ "branch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Depth-first search (DFS) goes as far as possible down one branch before backtracking.", what does "branch" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: branch /bræntʃ/ (danh từ): nhánh (đường đi). "Down one branch" = đi sâu theo một nhánh; "branch" còn là chi nhánh công ty hoặc nhánh Git.
items.explanationEn: branch /bræntʃ/ (noun): one path that splits off. "Down one branch" means along one path; "branch" can also be a company office or a Git branch.

items.question: Trong câu "Depth-first search (DFS) goes as far as possible down one branch before backtracking.", từ "backtrack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Depth-first search (DFS) goes as far as possible down one branch before backtracking.", what does "backtrack" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go back to an earlier point
items.explanation: backtrack /ˈbæktræk/ (động từ): quay lui. "Backtracking" = quay lui về điểm trước khi hết đường; cũng là tên một kỹ thuật thuật toán.
items.explanationEn: backtrack /ˈbæktræk/ (verb): to go back to an earlier point. "Backtracking" means returning to an earlier point; it also names an algorithm technique.

items.question: Trong câu "Recursion backtracks for free: the call stack remembers where to resume.", từ "resume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recursion backtracks for free: the call stack remembers where to resume.", what does "resume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resume /rɪˈzuːm/ (động từ): tiếp tục lại. "Where to resume" = chỗ để tiếp tục; khác với danh từ "résumé" = sơ yếu lý lịch.
items.explanationEn: resume /rɪˈzuːm/ (verb): to continue after a pause. "Where to resume" means where to continue; the noun "résumé" means a CV.

items.question: Trong câu "Recursion backtracks for free: the call stack remembers where to resume.", từ "for free" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recursion backtracks for free: the call stack remembers where to resume.", what does "for free" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: for free /fər friː/ (cụm từ): sẵn có, không tốn công. "Backtracks for free" = có sẵn việc quay lui mà không phải viết thêm code.
items.explanationEn: for free /fər friː/ (phrase): without extra effort. "Backtracks for free" means you get backtracking without writing extra code.

items.question: Trong câu "Space O(V) for visited/result plus up to O(V) call-stack frames — a long path-shaped graph can overflow the stack.", từ "overflow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space O(V) for visited/result plus up to O(V) call-stack frames — a long path-shaped graph can overflow the stack.", what does "overflow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overflow /ˌoʊvərˈfloʊ/ (động từ): tràn (bộ nhớ). "Overflow the stack" = làm tràn ngăn xếp (stack overflow); nghĩa gốc là nước tràn ra ngoài.
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˌoʊvərˈfloʊ/ (verb): to exceed a capacity. "Overflow the stack" means exceeding its limit; the basic sense is liquid spilling over.

items.question: Trong câu "An explicit stack (push/pop) replaces the call stack, so there is no recursion limit.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An explicit stack (push/pop) replaces the call stack, so there is no recursion limit.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): tường minh. "An explicit stack" = ngăn xếp do ta tự khai báo; trái nghĩa "implicit". "Explicit content" = nội dung nhạy cảm.
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated. "An explicit stack" is one you create yourself; the opposite is "implicit". "Explicit content" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The result A, C, E, F, D, B differs from the recursive A, B, D, E, C, F, yet both are depth-first: the stack is LIFO, so the most recently discovered vertex (C, pushed last) goes next.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result A, C, E, F, D, B differs from the recursive A, B, D, E, C, F, yet both are depth-first: the stack is LIFO, so the most recently discovered vertex (C, pushed last) goes next.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪfər/ (động từ): khác với. "A differs from B" = A khác B; đừng nhầm với "defer" = trì hoãn.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪfər/ (verb): to be unlike. "A differs from B" means they are not the same; do not confuse with "defer", to postpone.

items.question: Trong câu "The result A, C, E, F, D, B differs from the recursive A, B, D, E, C, F, yet both are depth-first: the stack is LIFO, so the most recently discovered vertex (C, pushed last) goes next.", từ "yet" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result A, C, E, F, D, B differs from the recursive A, B, D, E, C, F, yet both are depth-first: the stack is LIFO, so the most recently discovered vertex (C, pushed last) goes next.", what does "yet" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: yet /jet/ (liên từ): nhưng, tuy vậy. "..., yet both are depth-first" = nhưng cả hai đều là DFS; "not yet" = vẫn chưa.
items.explanationEn: yet /jet/ (conjunction): but even so. "..., yet both are depth-first" means "but even so"; "not yet" means "up to now, no".

items.question: Trong câu "To reproduce the recursive order, push neighbours in reverse and mark vertices when popped (skipping already-visited ones).", từ "reproduce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To reproduce the recursive order, push neighbours in reverse and mark vertices when popped (skipping already-visited ones).", what does "reproduce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reproduce /ˌriːprəˈduːs/ (động từ): tạo lại giống hệt. "Reproduce the order" = tạo lại đúng thứ tự đó; "reproduce a bug" = tái hiện lỗi.
items.explanationEn: reproduce /ˌriːprəˈduːs/ (verb): to produce again. "Reproduce the order" means to get the same order again; "reproduce a bug" means to make it happen again.

items.question: Trong câu "To reproduce the recursive order, push neighbours in reverse and mark vertices when popped (skipping already-visited ones).", từ "in reverse" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To reproduce the recursive order, push neighbours in reverse and mark vertices when popped (skipping already-visited ones).", what does "in reverse" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in reverse /ɪn rɪˈvɜːrs/ (cụm từ): theo thứ tự ngược. "Push neighbours in reverse" = đẩy hàng xóm theo thứ tự ngược lại.
items.explanationEn: in reverse /ɪn rɪˈvɜːrs/ (phrase): in the opposite order. "Push neighbours in reverse" means from last to first.

items.question: Trong câu "Breadth-first search (BFS) visits every neighbour at the current distance before going further — ripples on water.", từ "current" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breadth-first search (BFS) visits every neighbour at the current distance before going further — ripples on water.", what does "current" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: current /ˈkɜːrənt/ (tính từ): hiện tại. "The current distance" = khoảng cách đang xét; danh từ "current" = dòng điện, dòng chảy.
items.explanationEn: current /ˈkɜːrənt/ (adjective): happening now. "The current distance" is the one being processed now; the noun "current" means a flow.

items.question: Trong câu "Breadth-first search (BFS) visits every neighbour at the current distance before going further — ripples on water.", từ "further" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breadth-first search (BFS) visits every neighbour at the current distance before going further — ripples on water.", what does "further" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: further /ˈfɜːrðər/ (trạng từ): xa hơn. "Before going further" = trước khi đi xa hơn; "further" còn có nghĩa "thêm nữa" (further details).
items.explanationEn: further /ˈfɜːrðər/ (adverb): to a greater distance. "Before going further" means to a greater distance; "further details" means additional ones.

items.question: Trong câu "Breadth-first search (BFS) visits every neighbour at the current distance before going further — ripples on water.", từ "ripple" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breadth-first search (BFS) visits every neighbour at the current distance before going further — ripples on water.", what does "ripple" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ripple /ˈrɪpl/ (danh từ): gợn sóng lan tỏa. "Ripples on water" = gợn sóng lan dần ra, hình ảnh BFS lan theo từng tầng; "ripple effect" = hiệu ứng lan tỏa.
items.explanationEn: ripple /ˈrɪpl/ (noun): a small spreading wave. "Ripples on water" spread out in rings, like BFS layers; a "ripple effect" is a spreading impact.

items.question: Trong câu "shift() is O(n) on a JS array, so a read pointer keeps BFS at O(V + E) time, O(V) space.", từ "pointer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "shift() is O(n) on a JS array, so a read pointer keeps BFS at O(V + E) time, O(V) space.", what does "pointer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pointer /ˈpɔɪntər/ (danh từ): biến chỉ vị trí. "A read pointer" = biến chỉ số vị trí đọc tiếp theo; "pointers" (số nhiều) còn có nghĩa là lời khuyên.
items.explanationEn: pointer /ˈpɔɪntər/ (noun): a variable holding a position. "A read pointer" is an index for the next item to read; "some pointers" can also mean tips.

items.question: Trong câu "In an unweighted graph BFS reaches vertices in order of distance, so the first arrival at a vertex is along a path with the fewest edges.", từ "in order of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In an unweighted graph BFS reaches vertices in order of distance, so the first arrival at a vertex is along a path with the fewest edges.", what does "in order of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in order of /ɪn ˈɔːrdər əv/ (cụm từ): theo thứ tự của. "In order of distance" = theo thứ tự khoảng cách; khác "in order to" = để mà.
items.explanationEn: in order of /ɪn ˈɔːrdər əv/ (phrase): sorted by. "In order of distance" means sorted by distance; compare "in order to", meaning "so that".

items.question: Trong câu "In an unweighted graph BFS reaches vertices in order of distance, so the first arrival at a vertex is along a path with the fewest edges.", từ "arrival" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In an unweighted graph BFS reaches vertices in order of distance, so the first arrival at a vertex is along a path with the fewest edges.", what does "arrival" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the act of reaching a place
items.explanation: arrival /əˈraɪvl/ (danh từ): sự đến nơi. "The first arrival at a vertex" = lần đầu tiên tới một đỉnh; "arrival time" = giờ đến.
items.explanationEn: arrival /əˈraɪvl/ (noun): the act of reaching a place. "The first arrival at a vertex" is the first time you reach it; "arrival time" is when you get somewhere.

items.question: Trong câu "Store each vertex's parent, then walk back", từ "walk back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Store each vertex's parent, then walk back", what does "walk back" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to trace back step by step
items.explanation: walk back /wɔːk bæk/ (cụm từ): lần ngược lại. "Walk back" ở đây = đi ngược từ đích về nguồn theo parent; nghĩa khác "walk back a claim" = rút lại phát biểu.
items.explanationEn: walk back /wɔːk bæk/ (phrase): to trace back step by step. "Walk back" here means tracing parents from end to start; "walk back a claim" means to retract it.

items.question: Trong câu "With weighted edges, fewest edges is not cheapest — that is Dijkstra's algorithm, next topic.", từ "cheap" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With weighted edges, fewest edges is not cheapest — that is Dijkstra's algorithm, next topic.", what does "cheap" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cheap /tʃiːp/ (tính từ): tốn ít chi phí. "Cheapest path" = đường có tổng trọng số nhỏ nhất, không nhất thiết ít cạnh nhất.
items.explanationEn: cheap /tʃiːp/ (adjective): having low total cost. The "cheapest path" has the lowest total weight, not necessarily the fewest edges.

items.question: Trong câu "One traversal reaches only one component.", từ "component" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One traversal reaches only one component.", what does "component" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a connected part of a graph
items.explanation: component /kəmˈpoʊnənt/ (danh từ): thành phần liên thông. "Connected component" = thành phần liên thông; trong React, "component" là thành phần giao diện.
items.explanationEn: component /kəmˈpoʊnənt/ (noun): a connected part of a graph. A "connected component" is a group of linked vertices; in React, a "component" is a UI part.

items.question: Trong câu "Loop over every vertex and start a new traversal from each unvisited one; the number of starts is the number of components.", từ "loop over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Loop over every vertex and start a new traversal from each unvisited one; the number of starts is the number of components.", what does "loop over" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: loop over /luːp ˈoʊvər/ (cụm từ): lặp qua từng phần tử. "Loop over every vertex" = lặp qua mọi đỉnh; tương đương "iterate over".
items.explanationEn: loop over /luːp ˈoʊvər/ (phrase): to go through each item. "Loop over every vertex" means to visit each in a loop; similar to "iterate over".

items.question: Trong câu "Grids are implicit graphs.", từ "implicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Grids are implicit graphs.", what does "implicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: implicit /ɪmˈplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): ngầm định. "Implicit graph" = đồ thị ngầm, không lưu cạnh mà suy ra từ vị trí ô; trái nghĩa "explicit".
items.explanationEn: implicit /ɪmˈplɪsɪt/ (adjective): suggested, not stated. An "implicit graph" is not stored; its edges are worked out from cell positions. Opposite: "explicit".

items.question: Trong câu "In "number of islands" each cell is a vertex and its 4 neighbours are its edges — no adjacency list needed.", từ "cell" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In "number of islands" each cell is a vertex and its 4 neighbours are its edges — no adjacency list needed.", what does "cell" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cell /sel/ (danh từ): ô (trong lưới). "Each cell is a vertex" = mỗi ô lưới là một đỉnh; trong sinh học "cell" là tế bào.
items.explanationEn: cell /sel/ (noun): one box in a grid. "Each cell is a vertex" means each box of the grid; in biology, a "cell" is a unit of life.

items.question: Trong câu "Cycle detection, topological sort and union-find build on these traversals in a later topic.", từ "build on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cycle detection, topological sort and union-find build on these traversals in a later topic.", what does "build on" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to construct on top of land
items.explanation: build on /bɪld ɑːn/ (cụm từ): dựa trên để phát triển. "Build on X" = dựa trên X để phát triển tiếp; "build on previous work" = kế thừa công trình trước.
items.explanationEn: build on /bɪld ɑːn/ (phrase): to use as a foundation. "Build on X" means to use X as a base; "build on previous work" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Cycle detection, topological sort and union-find build on these traversals in a later topic.", từ "detection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cycle detection, topological sort and union-find build on these traversals in a later topic.", what does "detection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: detection /dɪˈtekʃn/ (danh từ): sự phát hiện. "Cycle detection" = phát hiện chu trình; "fraud detection" = phát hiện gian lận.
items.explanationEn: detection /dɪˈtekʃn/ (noun): the act of finding. "Cycle detection" means finding cycles; "fraud detection" uses the same word.

items.question: Trong câu "A graph is vertices + edges; trees are restricted graphs.", từ "restricted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A graph is vertices + edges; trees are restricted graphs.", what does "restricted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: restricted /rɪˈstrɪktɪd/ (tính từ): bị giới hạn. "Restricted graphs" = đồ thị có thêm ràng buộc (không chu trình, liên thông); "restricted access" = quyền truy cập hạn chế.
items.explanationEn: restricted /rɪˈstrɪktɪd/ (adjective): limited by rules. "Restricted graphs" follow extra rules; "restricted access" means limited access.

items.question: Trong câu "Clarify directed/undirected, weighted/unweighted, possible cycles and disconnected parts.", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clarify directed/undirected, weighted/unweighted, possible cycles and disconnected parts.", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Clarify the requirements" = làm rõ yêu cầu, bước quan trọng đầu buổi phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklærəfaɪ/ (verb): to make clear. "Clarify the requirements" means to make them clear, a key first step in interviews.

items.question: Trong câu "Mark visited on enqueue; avoid shift() in a hot loop; deep recursive DFS can overflow the stack.", từ "hot loop" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mark visited on enqueue; avoid shift() in a hot loop; deep recursive DFS can overflow the stack.", what does "hot loop" (phrase) mean?
options: vòng lặp chạy rất nhiều lần
optionsEn: a loop that runs very often
items.explanation: hot loop /hɑːt luːp/ (cụm từ): vòng lặp chạy rất nhiều lần. "Hot loop" = đoạn lặp chạy liên tục, nơi chi phí nhỏ cũng bị nhân lên.
items.explanationEn: hot loop /hɑːt luːp/ (phrase): a loop that runs very often. A "hot loop" runs so often that small costs add up.

items.question: Trong câu "BFS yields fewest-edge paths; repeated traversals count connected components.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BFS yields fewest-edge paths; repeated traversals count connected components.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): cho ra, tạo ra. "BFS yields ..." = BFS cho ra kết quả; "yield to traffic" = nhường đường.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce as a result. "BFS yields ..." means it produces that result; "yield to traffic" means to give way.

items.question: Trong câu "Graphs model relationships: social networks, maps, links, dependencies, recommendations.", từ "relationship" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Graphs model relationships: social networks, maps, links, dependencies, recommendations.", what does "relationship" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: relationship /rɪˈleɪʃnʃɪp/ (danh từ): mối quan hệ. "Model relationships" = mô hình hóa các mối quan hệ giữa các đối tượng.
items.explanationEn: relationship /rɪˈleɪʃnʃɪp/ (noun): a connection between things. "Model relationships" means to represent connections between things.
